description: An organizer swaps two entrants in the current Swiss round. Use the round, table numbers and ordered player ids from get_my_event. Confirm the affected tables before calling. Requires mcp:manage.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

round.description: The current Swiss round from get_my_event.

tables.description: The table numbers of the two players, in the same order as players.

name: swap_tournament_table_seats
title: Swap players between tournament tables
